title: Na Pooch Karbobala
body:
na pooch karbobala kis tarha basayi gayi
falak rida se lahoo se zameen banayi gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
saja diya gaya har ek ashk abid ka
rida e arsh se taaron se jab sajayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghuta hai shaam ke zindan may dam sakina ka
kise khabar ye hawa kis tarha chalayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahi hai mashk e sakina se pyaas asghar ki
sabeel pani ki ye kis tarha lagayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ek diya shab e ashoor jo bujhaya gaya
usi ke sadqe may ye roshni banayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
kise khabar sar e zainab se li gayi chadar
ahad ke parde may tauheed jab chupayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasam hai asr ki hal min se li gayi awaaz
sada e kun jo ba-roz e azal lagayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nauha tab kahin jaa kar hua supurd e qalam
naved aankh se jab juwe khoon bahayi gayi
na pooch karbobala...
author: Ahmed Naved
